card.name: Odd symbols inside codes and links
card.fires_on: Stray symbols such as @, + and digits inside email addresses, URLs, enzyme names, and bracketed reference codes. The pole is negative at these points.

modes.label: @ in addresses or text
modes.description: An at-sign inside an email-style address or starting a stray reply or note.

modes.label: + or / in URLs
modes.description: A plus or slash joining parts of a web address.

modes.label: Digit inside a code
modes.description: A digit within a gene, residue, or reference label.

card.plain: It reacts to odd symbols and digits inside web addresses, emails, and reference codes.
